final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT c.SupportRepId AS rep, e.City AS city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY c.SupportRepId, e.City), s2 AS (SELECT city, AVG(cnt) AS avgc FROM s1 GROUP BY city), s3 AS (SELECT s1.rep AS rep, s1.city AS city, s1.cnt AS cnt, s1.cnt - s2.avgc AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON CAST(s1.city AS TEXT) = CAST(s2.city AS TEXT) WHERE s1.cnt > s2.avgc), s4 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.rep, s3.city, s3.cnt, s3.diff, CAST(s3.cnt AS REAL) / s4.total AS ratio FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.total IS NOT NULL) SELECT city, SUM(cnt), AVG(diff), AVG(ratio) FROM s5 GROUP BY city
